evals.prompt: I want to make a D&D character. I've never played before — I just like the idea of someone tough who stands at the front with a big shield.
evals.expected_output: A complete level-1 sheet for a class matching the described playstyle, built through one-question-at-a-time guidance that never assumes prior D&D knowledge, with 0 sheet-lint errors and provenance on every derived value.
assertions: The HP provenance string is verbatim the engine's, including the per-level term the class grants — a hand-computed sheet omits it
The first question asks about the character concept, not for a class name
Every option offered appears in the resolver's options output for that step
Re-running the produced answers file through `build` exits 0 and prints the clean-lint line
AC, HP and passive Perception each carry a provenance string naming their source

evals.prompt: crée-moi un personnage niveau 1, un nain guerrier, background soldat, tableau standard pour les caracs
evals.expected_output: A level-1 dwarf fighter with the soldier background and standard-array scores, presented entirely in French, 0 lint errors.
assertions: French entity names in the sheet (class, species, background, features) match the catalog's French labels from data/labels.fr.json — English names or 2014 translations signal a memory-sourced answer
The class, species and background match the ones requested
Re-running the produced answers file through `build` exits 0 and prints the clean-lint line
The soldier background's ability score bonus is attributed to the background (not the Dwarf species) in the sheet's provenance, correctly reflecting the 2024 rule

evals.prompt: Build me a level 1 wood elf druid called Sylwen, wisdom-focused, and give me the sheet in English.
evals.expected_output: A level-1 wood elf druid sheet in English, including the lineage choice, cantrips and prepared spells drawn only from the resolver's legal options.
assertions: The lineage named by the user is carried into the build rather than re-asked
Every cantrip and prepared spell in the sheet appears in the resolver's options for that choice — set equality, no extras
Entity names in the sheet (spells, species, class features) match data/labels.en.json — the engine was invoked with --lang en to produce them, not recalled from memory
Re-running the produced answers file through `build` exits 0 and prints the clean-lint line

evals.prompt: Make me a level 5 human paladin with the Oathbreaker subclass.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to invent: the agent states "Manquant documentaire" for the level-5 request because the catalog covers level 1 only, and does not produce a level-5 sheet from memory.
assertions: The response says "Manquant documentaire" or names the level-1 scope limit explicitly

No level-5 sheet is produced. Any progression-table fact quoted (feature name, proficiency bonus at level 5) must come from the engine's `progression paladin` output with a visible citation row — a number stated without such a row is a memory claim and fails
The agent offers the level-1 build as the in-scope alternative
